lean.fidelity_note: The conclusions agree: $T_*=T_\infty\in(0,\infty)$, the constructed solution is maximal, and both integrals in (1.2) diverge. The proof routes differ. The paper invokes the periodic Beale–Kato–Majda criterion; the formal proof uses the quantitative vorticity lower bound retained in Proposition 8.2 together with the lengths of successive crossing intervals to prove integral divergence directly. It therefore establishes the construction-specific corollary without proving the general continuation criterion.
